proof_body:
by
  intro a p x
  by_cases hx : x = p
  · subst hx
    constructor <;> intro _ <;> simp
  · have hs : 0 < (x - p) ^ 2 := by
      have : x - p ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hx
      positivity
    constructor
    · intro ha
      have h := mul_pos ha hs
      exact ⟨h.le, not_lt.2 h.le, ⟨fun _ => hx, fun _ => h⟩, ⟨fun h' => absurd h' (not_le.2 h), fun h' => absurd h' hx⟩⟩
    · intro ha
      have h := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos ha hs
      exact ⟨h.le, not_lt.2 h.le, ⟨fun _ => hx, fun _ => h⟩, ⟨fun h' => absurd h' (not_le.2 h), fun h' => absurd h' hx⟩⟩
